title: Untitled (Football Field Collage)
description: Mixed-media collage bordered by floppy disks and bolted black framing, enclosing a central white field with perforated dot rows and compass-like instruments. Surrounding elements include an american football, target bullseye, warplane diagrams, orange rectangles, rainbow stripes, and handwritten text reading 'XXXIII das'.
composition: floppy-disk border frames central white field
